name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Operations & MarTech Implementation Specialist
summary: Marketing operations builder with 15+ years across SaaS, agency, and service-business environments, including 5+ years architecting CRM and marketing-automation systems end to end. Built and maintain 20+ production automation workflows (lead capture, routing, qualification, booking), run technical SEO audits and CMS-level fixes, and track performance through GA4 and campaign attribution. Comfortable as the technical liaison between marketing/SEO stakeholders and delivery, translating requirements into implementation tickets, documenting configurations, and troubleshooting breaks in lead-routing and tracking systems across multiple concurrent client accounts.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architect and maintain 20+ production GoHighLevel automation workflows spanning lead capture, tagging, routing, qualification, appointment booking with confirmation/reminders, no-show recovery, and post-sale nurture, monitoring and repairing broken automations between lead sources and downstream systems.
Run technical SEO audits, keyword-gap analysis, and competitor research, implementing on-page fixes (metas, alt tags, robots.txt, on-site improvements) directly inside client CMS platforms.
Track and validate lead-source and conversion accuracy using GA4 and CRM analytics across concurrent client accounts, reconciling reporting against ad-platform data to catch tracking discrepancies.
Document CRM architecture, workflow logic, and client-specific configuration quirks in Notion and HubSpot, keeping project records auditable across concurrent engagements and enabling clean handoffs.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' requirements into precise, structured automation logic and implementation steps, acting as the bridge between business intent and technical execution.
Built an automated prospect-audit workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts, scoring each business's digital footprint and site health to trigger personalized outreach and follow-up.
Design and deploy CRM architecture, contact segmentation, and lifecycle-stage logic across GoHighLevel and HubSpot, applying consistent data-hygiene protocols across every build.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94%) during tenure, guiding each through technical setup and configuration of reputation-management and marketing-automation tools.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction and shortened time-to-adoption for new partners and their end customers.
Served as frontline technical support for partner-facing product issues, triaging configuration problems and escalating structured, high-priority feedback to Product and Engineering.
Analyzed partner utilization and adoption metrics to identify workflow breaks and configuration gaps, recommending fixes that reduced churn.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets across a combined sales-and-implementation role.

Led digital-growth consultations aligning site architecture, on-page SEO, and technical setup, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Guided new-brand and new-vertical launches from proof of concept to live production accounts, documenting configuration quirks and building the onboarding process used by the rest of the team.
Directly managed and trained a team of onboarding specialists, standardizing technical setup steps and QA checkpoints across concurrent client launches.
Drove team initiatives and process documentation for a brand-new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, including hiring and training new hires.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, then handed structured specs to the implementation team to execute against.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations for CRM and project-management software, troubleshooting technical configuration issues directly with C-suite stakeholders.
Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for nearly the full tenure while quota roughly doubled, closing deals of $20K and larger later in tenure.
Advised clients on CRM adoption and scalable system design aligned to their growth stage, escalating account-level technical risk to leadership early.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance-marketing agency, covering campaign execution, tracking accuracy, and cross-team communication.
Built and refined internal reporting processes that improved data accuracy and reduced handoff errors between sales and delivery.
Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each, including several above $25K, for roughly $130K+ in total bookings.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
